title: Context-intelligence Unit F: promotion benchmark, operating runbook, deterministic status projection (D-013)
objective: Before/after benchmark over the frozen representative corpus (correctness first; the full promotion-evidence list of D-013), honest efficiency reporting with provider-token savings labeled unmeasured when unavailable, threshold proposal with rationale for the owner/control-plane promotion decision, the operating runbook, and the deterministic initiative status projection (bounded JSON + Markdown, Mermaid as view only, stale-marking by generating SHA).
business_reason: D-013 Unit F; promotion decision gate for the whole pipeline.
inputs: tools/repo_index_baseline.py capture_baseline (accepted A1 reference: UNMODIFIED full builder digests/counts — read-only)
tools/repo_index_incremental.py build_incremental + tools/repo_index_cache.py (accepted A2 new path + store — read-only)
tools/subsystem_entities.py AuthoritativeIndexes (accepted Unit C index digests — read-only)
project-control/tasks|gates|state + directives verification records + git (authoritative status-projection facts, read-only)

D-013 requirements R054-R060 (benchmark/promotion evidence/honest reporting/decision discipline), R061-R063 (deterministic status projection), R071 (rollback documentation), R012/R053/R057 (no invented savings)
outputs: tools/context_benchmark.py — deterministic frozen-corpus benchmark: the five directive-named task shapes (single-file bug, cross-module change, frontend/backend boundary, schema change, control-plane-only), reference (unmodified full builder via the accepted A1 harness) vs the new incremental path at the SAME SHA over the SAME snapshot (confound-removal method documented), cold/warm plus the R056 change classes (no-change, one-file, dependency change, delete, rename, config change, corrupt cache, interrupted write, concurrent writer); machine-readable report with correctness verdicts first, sample counts + median/p95 timings labeled measured-runtime, provider token savings labeled UNMEASURED

tools/status_projection.py — deterministic initiative status projection over the D-013 unit tasks from control-plane facts + git: R063 node fields (task id, requirement ids, dependencies, roles, branch + reviewed SHA, implementation files, evidence location, review-report digest, gates + state, accepted/blocked reason, rollback point), R062 status mapping, bounded canonical JSON + Markdown rendered FROM the JSON (Mermaid from the same JSON), generating-SHA + task/directive index digest stamps, and a stale-check mode
tools/test_context_benchmark.py + tools/test_status_projection.py — executable AS-1..AS-6 acceptance tests

docs/CONTEXT_PIPELINE_RUNBOOK.md — operating runbook: build/query/promotion flows, failure recovery, the R071 rollback path (disable the new index path without deleting the prior valid cache generation, restore full-build behavior, quarantine incompatible generations, committed why-evidence), and the R060 threshold proposal + PENDING owner promotion decision

project-control/reports/M0-T069-benchmark-report.json + M0-T069-benchmark-report.md (committed sanitized benchmark evidence) and M0-T069-status-projection.json + M0-T069-status-projection.md (the generated projection snapshot)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the deterministic frozen corpus covering the five directive-named task shapes
acceptance_scenarios.then: for every shape the reference (unmodified full builder) and the new incremental path run at the SAME SHA over the SAME snapshot (the confound-removal method is stated in the report), across cold and warm cache plus the R056 change classes: no-change, one-file change, dependency/export change, delete, rename, config change, corrupt cache, interrupted write, concurrent writer (D-013-R054/R056)

it machine-readably proves each R059 minimum: census accounts for every eligible file; incremental and clean-full exports are byte-identical per case; a warm no-change run reparses zero source files; a local change triggers no full rebuild unless a documented global invalidator changed; delete/rename leave no stale nodes or edges; corruption/crash/concurrency cases preserve a valid generation (D-013-R059)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the efficiency section of the report
acceptance_scenarios.then: correctness verdicts come first; timings carry sample counts with median/p95 where meaningful and are labeled measured runtime (never byte-identity content); deterministic reuse metrics (files parsed/reused) are reported separately; provider token savings are labeled UNMEASURED and no combined savings number exists anywhere (D-013-R057/R012/R053)

thresholds are PROPOSED with recorded rationale and the promotion decision is explicitly marked PENDING the owner/control-plane decision; nothing in Unit F flips any promotion flag or changes any accepted behavior (D-013-R060)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the status projection over the D-013 unit tasks
acceptance_scenarios.then: every value derives deterministically from control-plane files + git (never hand-maintained); each unit node carries the R063 fields (task id, exact requirement ids, dependency ids, roles, branch + current reviewed SHA, implementation files, evidence location, review-report digest, required gates with state, accepted/blocked reason, rollback point); statuses use the documented R062 mapping; the Markdown (and any Mermaid) renders FROM the same JSON; the projection declares its generating repository SHA + task/directive index digests, and the check mode exits nonzero when HEAD has moved (stale-marking) (D-013-R061/R062/R063)

acceptance_scenarios.given: unreadable control-plane inputs, and two runs at identical state
acceptance_scenarios.then: unreadable inputs fail closed with machine-readable codes; two projection runs at the same state are byte-identical; benchmark correctness sections are deterministic; the runbook documents the full R071 rollback path (disable the new index path WITHOUT deleting the prior valid cache generation, restore full-build behavior, quarantine incompatible generations, committed why-evidence) (D-013-R013/R071)

risks: Benchmark runtime: fixture repos are kept small so the suite stays CI-viable; sample counts recorded honestly
Promotion overreach: Unit F PROPOSES thresholds and reports evidence only; the promotion decision stays with the owner/control plane (R060) and no behavior flag changes
path_free_justification: Paths bound at claim (2026-08-18) after M0-T068 acceptance, per the D-013 sequencing reservation (source-002). New benchmark + status-projection modules consuming the accepted A1 baseline harness, A2 incremental path, and control-plane facts strictly read-only; no existing module is rewritten.
